comparison_policy: These are maxima or ranges reported by the cited papers in their native protocols. They are not pooled, normalized, or ranked against the same-stack Qwen3.5 deployment cohort.

rows.scope: Paged KV allocation plus serving engine
rows.native_setting: LLaMA-7B on A10G and LLaMA-13B on A100-40GB; vLLM serving engine
rows.reported_result: 2--4$\times$ serving throughput at similar latency vs. FasterTransformer/Orca
rows.quality_context: No common LongBench F1; exact cache-management method

rows.native_setting: Llama2/MPT/Falcon; RTX 4090, A40, and A100; HuggingFace-style prototype
rows.reported_result: 1.5--3.1$\times$ TTFT (CPU-resident modules); 3.7--11.7$\times$ (GPU-resident) on its 12-dataset LongBench suite
rows.quality_context: LongBench accuracy evaluated, but with different models and hardware

rows.native_setting: Llama-7B/Mixtral-8x7B and structured programs; A10G/A100; SGLang
rows.reported_result: Up to 6.4$\times$ throughput vs. prior inference systems
rows.quality_context: Application-suite result; no common LongBench F1

rows.scope: Prefix-aware KV chunks and attention kernel
rows.native_setting: attention microbenchmarks; mainly A100-80GB, plus A100-40GB/RTX 4090; CUDA 11.8
rows.quality_context: Kernel result; no end-to-end common task score

rows.native_setting: CodeLlama-13B/34B shared-prefix batches; A100 (with H100/L40S microbenchmarks); custom HuggingFace runtime
rows.reported_result: Up to 32$\times$ CodeLlama-13B end-to-end throughput in large shared-prefix batches
rows.quality_context: Exact attention construction; different model and batching regime

rows.native_setting: Llama/Mistral/LongChat quality studies; Llama-2-7B latency on one RTX 4090; HuggingFace plus custom kernels
rows.reported_result: 50\% KV compression and up to 1.89$\times$ RoPE-attention speedup; up to 2.91$\times$ with quantization
rows.quality_context: Llama/Mistral/LongChat native study; our bounded Qwen3.5 operator transfer is reported separately

rows.native_setting: Mistral-7B/Llama-3-70B request traces; two--eight GPUs across A6000/H100 clusters; distributed serving
rows.quality_context: Distributed serving traces; no common task score

rows.native_setting: Attention--Mamba2 7B geometry; LMSys/ShareGPT/SWE-bench traces; CloudLab policy simulation
rows.reported_result: Up to 34.4$\times$ token-hit rate and up to 71.1\% or 617 ms lower TTFT
rows.quality_context: Hybrid models and trace-driven policy study; no common LongBench F1

rows.scope: Position-independent caching for hybrid full/linear-attention models
rows.native_setting: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B main panels at TP=2 on 8 H20-3e; SGLang 0.5.14
rows.reported_result: 3.25$\times$ lower TTFT on average and 1.66$\times$ higher QPS over Prefix Cache
rows.quality_context: Four models/five workloads; our same-slice TP=1 timing and retained-state controls are reported separately
